priorFailures.liveAuditAssumptions: Three retained audit failures: query-redacted URL equality, missing finalUrl and null primaryResponse after a network-limit failure. No live reruns.

limitations: Feed metadata is unverified source advertising, not equivalent full content or authorization.
RSS/Atom remains literal text, not conformantly parsed XML or automatically followed items.
Four pre-existing native failures and one existing broad snapshot type error remain.
WhoWhatWear feed still exceeds the decoded network cap; no complete captured body exists.
BobVila exceeds the reader source cap; a native line window retains item metadata/teaser, not a complete item or substantive article body.
Ordinary native research mode rejects the reader-only text-prefix policy.
No JavaScript/SafeJS, credentials/passkeys, challenge solving, identity spoofing or browser-interaction acceptance.
